guesses.reason: The fluffy, dense white coat on the body and legs, sturdy big-boned puppy build, and tan 'badger' head markings are classic Great Pyrenees puppy traits.
The dark shading around the eyes and ears and the drop ears suggest a livestock guardian cross such as Anatolian Shepherd.
The symmetrical tan-and-black face patches with a white blaze and light eyes are also common in Aussie crosses.

breed.appearance: A chubby, fluffy puppy with a mostly white, medium-long plush coat covering the body, chest, and thick paws. The head has symmetrical golden-tan patches over both eyes and ears, with darker blackish-brown shading at the ear tips and around the eyes, a wide white blaze running up the forehead, and a white muzzle. It has soft folded drop ears, round blue-gray puppy eyes, a black nose, and often a little pink tongue tip peeking out.
breed.fun_fact: Great Pyrenees are gentle giants bred to guard flocks, so they're famously calm, loyal, and devoted to their families!
